decisions.reason: The candidate already requires usage measurement before Stripe integration; the new ledger details do not change Stripe payment behavior or its prerequisites.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: The usage-tracking layer should be built first, with Stripe integration coming afterward. For every Veyra AI call, Supabase will store the user, agent, prompt type, token usage, and estimated cost. That data will let us calculate average usage for each prompt type and base the subscription tiers on real measurements rather than guesses.
